activate.title: Activate this contract?
activate.body: Activating makes the contract live and begins billing. The client's name and tax number are frozen onto it as they stand now. You can still reverse this to draft while the contract has not been billed.

close.title: Close this contract?
close.body: Closing finalises the contract. No further certificates, invoices or variations can be raised against it. This cannot be undone.

reopen.title: Reopen this contract to draft?
reopen.body: This reverses a live contract back to draft so you can correct it, and clears the frozen client identity (re-activating freezes it again). If invoices have already been raised or payments collected against this contract, they will contradict the draft — change its scope through a Variation, or stop it with Terminate, instead.
